subject: AWS co-sell handshake request — Orion Labs pilot & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@amazon.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell handshake request — Orion Labs pilot & mutual action plan

Hi Priya,

Quick note — we have an active pilot conversation with Orion Labs (healthtech, retina screening device) where the customer is evaluating a hosted inference + private deployment for PHI data. The opportunity looks like a strong fit for an AWS co-sell (they want Marketplace procurement and a consolidated billing runway).

Short ask: can you connect us to the AWS account team / marketplace specialist who owns procurement & co-sell for Orion? We'd like a short 30 minute handshake to:
- Introduce the technical fit and compliance controls (SOC2, VPC options, KMS)
- Surface the proposed mutual action plan (attached draft) and procurement timeline
- Agree owner(s) from AWS for co-sell play and marketplace listing steps

I attached a one-page MA plan (OrionPilot_MAPlan_v1.pdf) and a checklist of marketplace artifacts. Proposed availability: Wed 3/17 between 10:00–14:00 PT or Thu 3/18 after 9:00 PT.

If useful, I can loop in Orion's buyer directly (Mike Lewis) after you confirm the right AWS contact.

Thanks — appreciate any intro you can make.

Connor O'Brien
Senior GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: OrionPilot_MAPlan_v1.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: Redwood_AWS-cosell-checklist.xlsx (3 sheets)
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@amazon.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Perez <michael.perez@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell handshake request — Orion Labs pilot & mutual action plan

Connor — thanks for the context and the materials. I reviewed the MA plan quickly; looks reasonable. I'll introduce you to Michael Perez (our Marketplace GTM lead) and to the account team covering Orion (I also copied Michael above).

A few quick questions before we loop in Orion:
- Does the pilot require Marketplace procurement right away or are they willing to buy via contract first and convert to Marketplace later?
- Any PHI-specific deployment constraints (on-prem only vs VPC peering vs PrivateLink)?

I'm available Wed 3/17 11:00–11:30 PT or 13:00–13:30 PT for a short handshake with Michael. If that works, please confirm and add Orion's buyer to the thread.

—Priya
Priya Sharma
Sr. Partner Solutions Manager, AWS Marketplace
priya.sharma@amazon.com | (206) 555-9876
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@amazon.com>, Michael Perez <michael.perez@amazon.com>, Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell handshake request — Orion Labs pilot & mutual action plan

Hi Priya / Michael / Mike — thanks for moving quickly.

Short answers to Priya's questions:
- Orion prefers Marketplace procurement but can sign a contract if Marketplace timing is a blocker. Goal is to have a billing path through AWS Marketplace by production launch (Q3).
- PHI constraints: customer will host data in a dedicated VPC with KMS for key management. They prefer PrivateLink where possible; we can support a VPC peering fallback. We'll include the network topology in the kickoff notes.

Mike, welcome — copied Anna Cook (CFO) on separate email to help with procurement cadence. Proposed handshake: Wed 3/17 13:00 PT (30 min) — agenda: intros (5), technical fit & compliance (10), procurement path & timelines (10), next steps & action owners (5).

Link to our shared MA plan & checklist: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/partnerships/OrionPilot

Connor / Laura — can you confirm if 13:00 PT is ok and share a brief pre-read (1 slide) for the kickoff? I put the deck in attachments for the thread.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mike Lewis <mike.lewis@orionlabs.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell handshake request — Orion Labs pilot & mutual action plan

Thanks — 13:00 PT works for me and Michael. Mike, welcome — looking forward to connecting. I'll send a calendar invite in the next 10 minutes (with Amazon/Orion/Redwood attendees).

Quick ask ahead of the call: could you drop a one-page architecture diagram (PNG or PDF) and the PA/BAA status for Orion's HIPAA controls in the thread? That helps the account team route the right security folks.
